title: From Metaheuristics to Exact Methods: A CP-SAT Approach for Multi-Objective Healthcare Workforce Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2608.30419v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Healthcare workforce scheduling is an NP-hard optimization problem requiring simultaneous satisfaction of labor regulations, coverage requirements, employee preferences and cost objectives. Existing approaches (genetic algorithms, integer programming, constraint programming) model 6-12 constraints at shift-level granularity and cannot guarantee regulatory compliance. They also lack support for multi-role, multi-skill heterogeneity, mandatory break scheduling with midpoint control, acuity-weighted workload equity, sub-shift granularity, inter-week stability, and cross-midnight shifts.   This paper presents CP-SAT: a Constraint Programming formulation for multi-role, multi-skill healthcare scheduling. CP-SAT enforces 14 hard constraints guaranteeing zero regulatory violations, while optimizing 15 soft objectives via a unified weighted penalty function. Contributions include a shift-window decomposition enabling break scheduling with centra

translated_title: 从元启发式方法到精确方法：面向多目标医疗人力调度的CP-SAT方法
translated_abstract: 医疗人力调度是一个NP难优化问题，需要同时满足劳动法规、人员覆盖需求、员工偏好和成本目标。现有方法（遗传算法、整数规划、约束规划）仅在班次级别的粒度上建模6-12个约束，无法保证法规合规性，并且缺乏对多角色、多技能异质性、带中点控制的强制休息调度、基于病情严重度加权的工作量公平性、子班次粒度、周间稳定性以及跨午夜班次的支持。本文提出了CP-SAT：一种面向多角色、多技能医疗人力调度的约束规划模型。CP-SAT强制执行14个硬约束以保证零法规违规，同时通过统一的加权惩罚函数优化15个软目标。贡献包括一种班次窗口分解方法，可实现带中点控制的休息调度……
tldr: 本文提出CP-SAT约束规划方法，通过14个硬约束保证医疗人力调度零法规违规，并以统一加权惩罚函数同时优化15个软目标，支持多角色多技能、强制休息调度、工作量公平性和跨午夜班次等复杂现实需求。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CP-SAT, a constraint programming formulation for multi-role, multi-skill healthcare workforce scheduling that enforces 14 hard constraints guaranteeing zero regulatory violations while optimizing 15 soft objectives through a unified weighted penalty function.
